detail.longDescription: Across 45 agent setups, model averages span 27.2 points. Each harness shifts the average by -0.7 to +0.6. That is InfoOrgBench: 9 models x 5 harnesses, Codex CLI among them, sorting meeting recaps, issue threads and design proposals into hierarchies. Best pair: 83.2/100. In every domain, parent-level links fail more than leaf-level ones. Here, tuning the harness before swapping the model is backwards. https:// arxiv.org/abs/2611.10600 # AIAgents # MachineLearning # LLM
